svg.title: A derivative of whole paths
svg.desc: Three curves share fixed initial and final positions; a smooth variation changes their interiors. A variation is a mathematical comparison with nearby candidate histories. The physical stationary path is found by requiring the first action change to vanish for every allowed variation.

g.text: Vary the route, not its endpoints

svg.aria-label: Every nearby path has an action S(ε).

g.text: The varied paths need not obey the motion law.
